scope: E32 candidate-only Key probing, existing two development trajectories, 288 events per frozen C/E29 seed17/29; no training, new QKV, Test, Kernel or new persistent deployed cache
sampling: Uniform without replacement within each physical 16-token subgroup. PCG64 seed from SHA256(trajectory/layer/head/sampling_seed, ordered token IDs). No values, true logZ, gains, or model seed in sampling. First b of one permutation; same physical IDs reuse offsets across contexts and both C seeds. Plans generated and hashed before evaluation.
candidate_pages: Union of initial Medium 16 remove and32 add pages; own excluded; same candidate pages for same-info Independent and Set. Counterfactual analysis reuses these probes, not new queries or refreshed candidate pools.
estimator: logZprobe=logsumexp(q dot sampled_K/sqrt128)+log(16/b) over four groups and b tokens; beta=logZprobe-logZsummary. Only M16 queries. No V probe, bias correction, coefficient fit, clipping or repeated-probe acceptance gate.
frozen: E29 local response and all background beta, E24 C summary, E27 phi, B16, Risk, K/own budget, single Medium swap/no-op
main_evaluation: Real Q64 pre-W_O NMSE; aggregate within sampling seed and averaged over all5 seeds. Baselines counted once per model seed. No selection of favorable random seeds. Same-info Independent uses one legal swap or no-op.
information_gate: For b2 or b4, BOTH C seeds: mean Set gain exceeds E29 and same-info Independent; closes >=50% Candidate-True minus E29 gain gap (gap must be positive); each development trajectory positive mean actual gain; at least4/5 sampling seeds exceed E29 aggregate gain. Exploratory consistency filter, not statistical significance across independent videos.
reliability_gate: Separate: mean per-event improvement nonnegative, mean degradation rate <=15%, P10 and worst relative tail better than E29. No gain-only success claim, no Test or automatic Kernel even if passed.
stop: No b>4 or broader sampling sweep; if unreliable stop, do not approach full page computation.
cost: Incremental Key bytes and QK FLOPs only; count actual48 candidates and K21 or41; retain all frozen Reader/summary/scoring overhead separately; no V, no credit for hypothetical Key reuse or ideal gathers. Five seeds are repeated experiments, not5-probe deployment ensemble. No measured latency claim.
